entries.symptom: The git commit command wrapper times out while pre-commit validation is still running.
entries.cause: The repository pre-commit hook runs formatting, linters, and tests and can outlive a short command timeout; the commit may already have completed.
entries.fix: Inspect git status and git log -1 before retrying. If the commit did not complete, inspect the newest file under .git/hook-logs, fix the reported failure, and rerun git commit with hooks enabled.

entries.symptom: The git push command wrapper times out while the pre-push test suites continue running.
entries.cause: The repository pre-push hook runs full frontend and backend verification and may exceed a short command timeout.
entries.fix: Inspect the remote branch state, git status, and git log -1 before retrying. If the push failed, inspect .git/hook-logs, resolve the failing suite, and rerun git push without bypassing hooks.

entries.symptom: CI reports WHITESPACE formatting failures after an EF Core migration is added or regenerated.
entries.cause: Generated migration, designer, or model snapshot files do not match the repository whitespace rules.
entries.fix: Run dotnet format whitespace for FoodDiary.Infrastructure, retain both migration files, and confirm generated migration and snapshot classes remain excluded from coverage.

entries.symptom: LLM Wiki CI intermittently fails the index-selection smoke after a successful concurrent index refresh; the waiter reruns or misses the lock overlap window.
entries.cause: The concurrency regression used a roughly three-second domain-data generator. Under parallel Linux runner load, the parent can observe lock ownership near process completion and start the waiter after the owner releases the lock.
entries.fix: Use the slower single-generator runtime-topology refresh and retry up to three times only when lock ownership or the overlap window was lost; every successful attempt must still observe the exclusive lock and concurrent receipt reuse.
verification: Run Test-LlmWikiConcurrentIndexUpdate.ps1 on Windows and Linux, then run Invoke-LlmWikiAffectedSmoke.ps1 -Group index-selection.
